title: Forestrie docs: shared frontmatter definitions
description: Field shapes shared by every document type (ADR-0071 section 6). Not a document schema on its own; the per-type schemas compose `base` and add their own fields.

date.description: ISO 8601 calendar date. Tooling loads YAML with dates kept as strings.

home.description: A forestrie repository name used as a citation namespace, e.g. devdocs, canopy, protocol.

canonRef.description: A reference to a canon document. One of: a citation (`ADR-0071`, `devdocs:ADR-0071`), a filename stem (`adr-0023-grant-format`, `canopy:arc-0004-sequencing`) for ids that collide, a repo-relative path (`architecture.md`, `protocol:rules/platform.md#p4`), or an https URL. A bare citation or path resolves inside the citing document's own home.

workRef.description: A plan or status snapshot id in forestrie/work: `plan-YYMM-NN-<slug>`, `status-YYMM-NN-<slug>`, or a frozen legacy `plan-NNNN-<slug>` / `status-NNNN-<slug>`.

issueRef.description: A Linear issue on team FOR.

base.description: Fields every document type accepts. Per-type schemas set `required` and the `id` and `status` shapes.

supersedes.description: Documents this one replaces. Each of them carries `superseded-by` pointing back here.

superseded-by.description: The one document that replaced this one.

absorbed-into.description: Named living documents or rules of the road that now carry this document's substance.

decisions.description: In-force ADRs and ARCs that shaped this document.

refs.description: Anything else this document depends on or serves: canon, work ids, FOR issues.

^x-[a-z0-9-]+$.description: Extension fields. Tooling ignores them; promote a field into the schema once two repos use it.
